mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the horizon in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4% signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates increased economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns as corporate output and revenues grow.
failure_condition: Industrial production growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, negatively impacting equity valuations and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate above 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment is low and payroll employment is high, the labor market is strong, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Low unemployment and high payroll employment but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail and food services sales indicate strong consumer demand, leading to higher revenues and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Retail sales growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates coupled with rising CPI indicate inflationary pressures, negatively impacting equity valuations and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: High federal funds rate and CPI growth but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production and housing starts indicate strong economic activity, leading to increased corporate output and positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Industrial production and housing starts growth but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
